name: construct-map
title: Construct Map
description: A linear construct map, the plasmid map unrolled: forward features above the backbone and reverse below as rounded bars with arrow tips, lanes for overlaps, joined features as blocks on a line, names inside, beside or in a label row (a legend on narrow maps), restriction sites on two fanned rows, a ruler, zoom (buttons, Ctrl-wheel, double-click a feature) down to both strands of the sequence with amino acids under each codon, an overview to drag, range selection with length and GC, hover cards and a keyboard stop; sliceConstruct cuts out a stretch (a PCR product, across the origin too). Takes the same features as Plasmid Map, so parseGenBank output renders either way.
